analysis: The code snippet calls System.getProperty with constant string keys: 'os.name', 'java.home', 'java.version'. These keys are non-null and non-empty, so NullPointerException and IllegalArgumentException are avoided. There is no security manager check or try-catch block, so SecurityException can still occur if a security manager denies access to the system properties.
answer: NullPointerException: avoided; IllegalArgumentException: avoided; SecurityException: not avoided
remark: SecurityException will be thrown if a security manager is installed and the calling code lacks permission to read the specified system property (e.g., in a restricted environment). The method does not catch or prevent this exception.
